items.docs: List all worker groups for the current organization (paginated).
Create a new worker group in the current organization.
Get details of a specific worker group including its members.
Update a worker group's name and/or description.
Soft-delete a worker group. Existing HITL task assignments are preserved.

info.name: Add or remove members from a worker group

items.docs:
Add and/or remove members from a worker group in a single call.

Users in add_user_ids that are already members are silently skipped.
Users in remove_user_ids that are not members are silently ignored.

info.name: Get credit balance for current user's organization

items.docs:
Get credit balance for the current user's organization.

Returns the current credit balance including grants, consumption, and remaining credits
for the authenticated user's organization. Consumption is read from the
credit_usage_summary materialized view, refreshed every 10 minutes.

**Authorization**:
- Organization admins and users can view their own organization's credits
- RLS policies enforce organization-level data isolation at database level

**Context**:
- Credits are tracked at the org

Update organization settings.

This endpoint replaces settings in the organization's settings JSONB column.
Only admins can update settings. Uses JWT token to identify the organization.

Configuration Options for worker_landing_page:
    - hub: Workers land on the Hub page
    - assigned_flow_data_tab: Workers land on their assigned flow's Data Tab
    - assigned_flow_work_tab: Workers land on their assigned flow's Work Tab

Returns:
    Full organization object with updated settings

Note:

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the organization to retrieve. Must be a valid UUID format.

items.docs:
Retrieve detailed information for a specific organization.

Fetches complete metadata for a single organization using its unique identifier.
Use this to verify organization existence, check active status, or retrieve
organization details before performing related operations.

Context:
    - Returns organization regardless of active/inactive status
    - Does not include user count or related entity counts
    - Organization ID must be a valid UUID
